name: London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)

deadline.intake: September 2027 entry, undergraduate via UCAS (13 Jan 2027, 18:00 GMT)

tuition.note: 2027/28 overseas fee, lowest band (e.g. BA History); ranges up to 41,900 depending on programme

requirement.text: Applications must be submitted through UCAS; LSE does not consider direct applications and does not interview applicants.
